pairs: cum consummasset Jesus, præcipiens duodecim discipulis suis,
when Jesus had completed instructing his twelve disciples,
transiit inde ut doceret, et prædicaret in civitatibus eorum.
he went away from there in order to teach and to preach in their cities.
Joannes autem cum audisset in vinculis opera Christi,
Now when John had heard, in prison, about the works of Christ,
sending two of his disciples, he said to him,
ait illi: Tu es, qui venturus es,
“Are you he who is to come,
And Jesus, responding, said to them:
Euntes renuntiate Joanni quæ audistis, et vidistis.
“Go and report to John what you have heard and seen.
et beatus est, qui non fuerit scandalizatus in me.
And blessed is he who has found no offense in me.”
cœpit Jesus dicere ad turbas de Joanne:
Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John:
“What did you go out to the desert to see?
A reed shaken by the wind?
So what did you go out to see?
those who are clothed in soft garments are in the houses of kings.
Then what did you go out to see?
Hic est enim de quo scriptum est:
For this is he, of whom it is written:
Ecce ego mitto angelum meum ante faciem tuam,
‘Behold, I send my Angel before your face,
qui præparabit viam tuam ante te.
who shall prepare your way before you.’
non surrexit inter natos mulierum major Joanne Baptista:
qui autem minor est in regno cælorum,
there has arisen no one greater than John the Baptist.
Yet the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
A diebus autem Joannis Baptistæ usque nunc,
But from the days of John the Baptist, even until now,
the kingdom of heaven has endured violence,
and the violent carry it away.
For all the prophets and the law prophesied,
et lex usque ad Joannem prophetaverunt:
And if you are willing to accept it,
Cui autem similem æstimabo generationem istam?
But to what shall I compare this generation?
Similis est pueris sedentibus in foro: qui clamantes coæqualibus
It is like children sitting in the marketplace,
who, calling out to their companions,
We lamented, and you did not mourn.’
The Son of man came eating and drinking;
Ecce homo vorax, et potator vini,
a man who eats voraciously and who drinks wine,
a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’
Et justificata est sapientia a filiis suis.
But wisdom is justified by her sons.”
Tunc cœpit exprobrare civitatibus, in quibus factæ sunt plurimæ virtutes ejus,
Then he began to rebuke the cities in which many of his miracles were accomplished,
for they still had not repented.
quia, si in Tyro et Sidone factæ essent virtutes quæ factæ sunt in vobis,
For if the miracles that were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon,
olim in cilicio et cinere pœnitentiam egissent.
they would have repented long ago in haircloth and ashes.
et Sidoni remissius erit in die judicii,
Tyre and Sidon shall be forgiven more than you,
would you be exalted all the way to heaven?
You shall descend all the way to Hell.
quia si in Sodomis factæ fuissent virtutes quæ factæ sunt in te,
For if the miracles that were done in you had been done in Sodom,
forte mansissent usque in hanc diem.
perhaps it would have remained, even to this day.
Yet truly, I say to you,
quia terræ Sodomorum remissius erit in die judicii, quam tibi.
that the land of Sodom shall be forgiven more than you, on the day of judgment.”
In illo tempore respondens Jesus dixit:
because you have hidden these things from the wise and the prudent,
and have revealed them to little ones.
quoniam sic fuit placitum ante te.
for this was pleasing before you.
Omnia mihi tradita sunt a Patre meo.
All things have been delivered to me by my Father.
Et nemo novit Filium, nisi Pater:
And no one knows the Son except the Father,
neque Patrem quis novit, nisi Filius,
nor does anyone know the Father except the Son,
and those to whom the Son is willing to reveal him.
Venite ad me omnes qui laboratis,
all you who labor and have been burdened,
and you shall find rest for your souls.
